zh.title: 萊茵金屬LUNA NG無人機獲德國軍方臨時適航認證
zh.summary: 德國軍方航空局給予萊茵金屬LUNA NG無人機臨時適航認證；許可訓練與測試飛行。
body: 德國軍方航空局（Luftfahrtamt der Bundeswehr，簡稱 LufABw）已向萊茵金屬（Rheinmetall）開發的 LUNA NG 無人偵察系統核發臨時適航認證。該項證書為取得完整機型認證的中間階段，萊茵金屬表示完整認證作業仍在持續進行中，且已符合大部分所需的審查基準。
取得臨時適航認證後，德國聯邦國防軍獲准使用 LUNA NG 系統開展自行控制的訓練與測試飛行任務。根據萊茵金屬公布的訊息，首批德國軍方飛行員與審查人員目前已經完成該型無人機的相關培訓課程。
萊茵金屬指出，在獲得軍方核准之前，LUNA NG 系統已在民用營運執照下完成大約 150 架次飛行，累計飛行時間約 200 小時。此項認證代表該型無人機能在符合民用安全標準的前提下整合至常規管制空域，擺脫僅能在純軍事區域飛行的限制。
萊茵金屬 Air Unmanned Space 事業部執行長 Mike Schmidt 表示，該系統的認證流程比照空中巴士A320等大型客機的標準執行。由於市面上缺乏適用於戰術無人機的現成獲認證組件，包含自動飛行控制系統與導航系統在內的安全關鍵部件均由公司自主研發並完成認證。
德國聯邦國防軍以 HUSAR 為代號引進 LUNA NG 系統。根據 2023 年 9 月 28 日簽署的合約修正案，採購內容涵蓋 12 套量產系統與 1 套先導系統，總金額約為 2 億歐元。每套系統配備 5 架無人機、2 套地面控制系統、2 輛發射車、2 座天線桅桿、維修車間及 3 套運輸平台。單架無人機最大起飛重量為 110 公斤，最高飛行高度達 5,000 公尺，續航時間超過 12 小時。

en.title: Rheinmetall LUNA NG Drone Receives Provisional Military Certification
en.summary: Germany's military aviation authority granted Rheinmetall LUNA NG drone provisional airworthiness certification for military training flights.
body: Germany's military aviation authority, the Luftfahrtamt der Bundeswehr (LufABw), has granted provisional airworthiness certification to the Rheinmetall LUNA NG unmanned reconnaissance system. According to Rheinmetall, the issued certificate represents an interim approval step toward full type certification, which remains in progress with the majority of required approval criteria already fulfilled.

The provisional certificate allows the Bundeswehr to conduct its own flight operations with the LUNA NG system for training and testing purposes. Rheinmetall confirmed that the first German military pilots and verifiers have already completed their official training on the unmanned aerial system type.

Prior to obtaining military approval, the LUNA NG system logged roughly 150 sorties totaling approximately 200 flight hours under civil operating licenses. Rheinmetall stated that the provisional airworthiness certification allows the reconnaissance drone to be integrated into regular restricted airspace while meeting civil safety standards, ending its confinement strictly to designated military zones.

Mike Schmidt, CEO of Rheinmetall's Air Unmanned Space business unit, explained that the certification process was conducted against the same rigorous standards applied to large commercial aircraft such as the Airbus A320. Key safety-critical components, including the autopilot and navigation systems, had to be engineered and certified in-house because no certified off-the-shelf equivalents were available for tactical unmanned aircraft.

The German armed forces are introducing the system under the military designation HUSAR. A contract amendment executed on September 28, 2023, covers 12 production systems and one pilot system valued at approximately 200 million euros (231 million dollars). Each complete system comprises five aircraft, two ground control stations, two launcher vehicles, two antenna masts, a dedicated repair shop, and three transport platforms. Rheinmetall specifies that each aircraft features a maximum takeoff weight of 110 kilograms, a maximum altitude of 5,000 meters, and an operating endurance of more than 12 hours.

zh.title: 加拿大航空選擇最多16架空中巴士A350-1000客機
zh.summary: 加拿大航空選擇最多16架空中巴士A350-1000客機，取代延遲的波音777X。
body: 根據相關消息，加拿大航空已選擇最多16架空中巴士A350-1000型廣體客機，以此替代已被推遲交付的波音777X系列客機。
在遠程客機機隊規劃方面，空中巴士A350-1000型客機已被加拿大航空納入選擇，用於因應波音777X計畫出現延遲後的長程航線運能需求。
根據波音公司於2026年7月發布的營運資料顯示，該公司針對波音777X客機計畫的首次交付時間，目前仍持續預計落在2027年。
加拿大航空此項相關機隊決策，呈現出航空業者在規劃未來長程客機機隊時所採行的具體考量與佈局。

en.title: Air Canada Selects Up to 16 Airbus A350-1000 Aircraft
en.summary: Air Canada selected up to 16 Airbus A350-1000 aircraft over Boeing's delayed 777X model.
body: Air Canada has selected up to 16 Airbus A350-1000 widebody aircraft to replace or substitute for Boeing's delayed 777X program in its future fleet plans.
The airline opted for the A350-1000 as part of its long-haul fleet strategy, addressing operational requirements amid ongoing program delays affecting the Boeing 777X aircraft.
According to previously reported financial update information from Boeing, the manufacturer maintains its expectation for the first delivery of the 777X aircraft to take place in 2027.
This commitment highlights broader shifts in how commercial carriers plan and structure their future long-haul fleets in response to aircraft delivery timelines.

zh.title: 波音MH-139A灰狼直升機獲准執行美國核彈飛彈田安全任務
zh.summary: 美空軍宣布MH-139A達初始作戰能力；接替UH-1N執行核彈護航
body: 美國空軍全球打擊司令部（AFGSC）於2026年8月31日宣布，波音MH-139A灰狼直升機已在8月10日達到初始作戰能力，正式獲准執行洲際彈道飛彈（ICBM）安全任務。這標誌著該型直升機將接替服役超過半世紀的UH-1N休伊直升機，負責守護彌尼特曼三型飛彈的維修與裝甲安保車隊。
灰狼是義大利李奧納多公司AW139雙引擎中型直升機的軍用改良型。李奧納多在位於費城東北部的廠房生產基礎機身，由波音作為主承包商加裝軍用設備並負責交付後支援。AFGSC表示，灰狼速度比前身快近50%，載員量翻倍，並具備改進的防禦系統。
首次作戰護航任務於2026年1月8日執行，第40直升機中隊兩架灰狼從馬姆斯特洛姆空軍基地出發，護送車隊往返超過100英里（約161公里），全程約六小時無需空中加油。第20航空隊責任區涵蓋懷俄明州沃倫基地、蒙大拿州馬姆斯特洛姆基地與北達科他州邁諾特基地，總面積約33,600平方英里。
根據波音2026年1月29日公開數據，合同共38架MH-139A，已交付21架，其中12架屬2023年簽署的低率初產合同。首架量產機於2024年8月移交。機隊仍在擴建中，AFGSC未說明宣告涵蓋多少架次、機組或基地。
AFGSC並將灰狼與未來LGM-35A哨兵洲際飛彈的轉換掛鉤，指稱其航程與指揮控制系統將支援分階段佈署：新哨兵設施啟用的同時逐步退役彌尼特曼三型據點。哨兵計劃以2030年代初達到初始作戰能力為目標。除護航外，灰狼亦將執行搜救、災害救援與醫療撤運任務。

en.title: Boeing MH-139A Grey Wolf cleared for US nuclear missile field security mission
en.summary: USAF declares MH-139A initial operational capability; replaces UH-1N for nuclear convoy escort
body: The US Air Force Global Strike Command (AFGSC) announced on August 31, 2026 that the Boeing MH-139A Grey Wolf helicopter reached initial operational capability on August 10, 2026, clearing it for the intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) security mission it was procured to perform. The declaration formalises the handover from the UH-1N Huey, which has flown in missile fields since 1970.

The Grey Wolf is a militarised derivative of the Leonardo AW139 twin‑engine commercial medium‑lift helicopter. Leonardo produces the baseline airframe at its plant in northeast Philadelphia, and Boeing, as prime contractor, installs the military equipment and handles post‑delivery support. AFGSC said the Grey Wolf is nearly 50% faster than its predecessor, carries twice as many troops and has improved defensive systems.

The type flew its first operational convoy on January 8, 2026, when two aircraft from the 40th Helicopter Squadron escorted a movement more than 100 miles (over 161 kilometres) from Malmstrom Air Force Base and back over roughly six hours without refuelling. The Twentieth Air Force area of responsibility spans approximately 33,600 square miles (87,000 square kilometres) across F.E. Warren AFB in Wyoming, Malmstrom AFB in Montana and Minot AFB in North Dakota.

The most recent public delivery total dates from January 29, 2026, when Boeing stated that 38 MH-139As were under contract and 21 had been delivered, 12 of them under the low‑rate initial production contract awarded in 2023. The first production aircraft was handed over in August 2024. AFGSC did not specify how many aircraft, crews or bases the initial operational capability declaration covers, and the fleet is still being built out.

AFGSC also tied the helicopter to the coming transition from Minuteman III to the LGM‑35A Sentinel, saying the Grey Wolf’s range and command‑and‑control systems are needed to secure sites through a phased transition in which new Sentinel facilities come online as Minuteman III sites are decommissioned. The Sentinel programme is targeting its own initial operational capability in the early 2030s. Beyond convoy escort and continuous emergency response, the Grey Wolf will also be used for search and rescue, disaster response and medical evacuation.
